design_condition: The slim volume is extended along the highway on a specially engineered foundation, while the canopy addresses the road and protects a broad, quiet outdoor space on the opposite side.

positive.statement: The foundation concept is intelligently thought out and enables uniform load transfer to the settlement-sensitive subsoil.

position.rationale: Approximate support location beneath the elevated south-west portion of the elongated volume.

positive.statement: The special foundation allows increased multi-story storage and reduces the building footprint.

position.rationale: Foundation is assigned beneath the north-east building footprint, supporting the reduced ground occupation.

positive.statement: The height development is used to accommodate the highway, while the canopy accentuates the road reference and provides noise protection.

position.rationale: Road-facing canopy is placed along the southern edge at the elevated upper volume.

positive.statement: The northern outdoor space impresses with its width, spaciousness, and meaningful emptiness.

position.rationale: Broad open area is placed on the north side opposite the road-facing canopy.

positive.statement: The project impresses with its rigorous independence and strikingly expresses its function as a mountain.

position.rationale: The complete slender, elevated, ship-shaped mass is visible across the calibrated views.

positive.statement: The seriousness and precision with which the project idea was developed become apparent on closer examination.

position.rationale: Precision and rigor are assigned to the visible overall massing and its sharply defined edges.

negative.statement: The delivery arrangement allows only one vehicle and is unacceptable given the expected vehicle movements.

position.rationale: Delivery activity is approximated at the south-east road-facing end of the building.

negative.statement: The necessary transshipment space is not provided, although goods can only be moved within the building using forklifts.

position.rationale: Missing transfer space is anchored near the inferred southern loading edge.

negative.statement: The ship-shaped volume is unsuitable for the collection-center function because its loading arrangement does not replicate the required ferry-like loading volume.

position.rationale: The elongated ship-shaped envelope is clearly visible, though its internal loading arrangement is not.

negative.statement: The first stage appears amputated, while the uncertain second stage and possible expansion are constitutive elements of the concept.

position.rationale: The apparent initial stage is assigned to the truncated south-west end of the elongated mass.

negative.statement: The canopy extending beyond the distance line represents a violation of building law.

position.rationale: The potentially noncompliant projection is located along the southern canopy edge.

negative.statement: The strength of the image is contradicted by important functional inadequacies.

position.rationale: The criticism concerns tension between the visible architectural image and building-wide functional performance.

negative.statement: The building's hermeticism turns against the desired spatial and communicative openness of the collection center.

position.rationale: Hermeticism is anchored to the visibly continuous enclosure surrounding the elongated volume.
